2001 was a very difficult year for <ORG>.  While our performance in wholesale energy and broadband Internet services was excellent, our power trading business lost over $800 million.  We also faced a variety of problems related to our merger with <ORG>, including a drop in <ORG>'s credit rating to "junk" status and a lawsuit filed by <ORG> shareholders.

On <DATE>, our Board of Directors took action to address these issues and position <ORG> for long-term success.  The Board approved a number of changes to our organizational structure and a plan to streamline our operations and reduce our costs.

To read more about the Board's decision and the changes to our organizational structure, please go to <URL>  This will take you to our "Open Discussions" webpage.  Select "Announcement" from the menu to the left and then click on the title "New Operational Standards Implemented."
BCO_Text:
Today, the <ORG> Board of Directors voted to approve a new set of operational standards that will help <ORG> better manage its market risk and strengthen its credit rating.

The new standards, which were developed in conjunction with the rating agencies, will help <ORG> achieve its goal of becoming the world's leading company.

The standards, which will be implemented over the next few days, include:

*	An increase in <ORG>'s consolidated equity cushion by $1 billion through a combination of retained earnings and additional equity issuance. This will result in a pro forma equity ratio of 11 percent, which is above the rating agencies' average for Aaa-rated companies and significantly above peer utilities' equity ratios.
*	A maximum consolidated debt-to-equity ratio of 10:1, excluding transient hedges.
*	A maximum trading-book debt-to-equity ratio of 7:1, excluding transient hedges.
*	A maximum trading-liquidity ratio of 25:1.

The Board also voted to continue to pursue an Aaa credit rating for <ORG>.

With these new standards in place, <ORG> will now focus on achieving its credit rating goal and regaining investor confidence.

Thank you for your continued support.

<PER> Piper
Chief Financial Officer
